narrative.details: adventurer, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
narrative.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great champion, adventurer. Maintain your vigilance and dedication! You are ready for your next lesson in service.
